Chapter 6523: Do What You Must

Chapter 6523: Do What You Must

“Young Noble, you’re back to take care of this?” He asked softly.

“Those who deserve death will not escape.” Li Qiye smiled.

“I’m one of them.” He said.

“Focus on redeeming yourself then, I don’t need to be bothered with this, do I?” Li Qiye said.

“Of course not, I will deal with it myself.” He said.

Li Qiye smiled before noticing something above. The high priest did the same and gazed at the sky.

***

A supreme beauty attacked the outer barrier of the minor realm, utilizing the power of an apex primal ancestor.

She dealt enough damage to form a hole in the first barrier and flew inside. Alas, the second barrier stopped all of her attacks.

She didn’t give up and summoned a treasure given by her master for an apocalyptic blow. This ended with the blast being nullified and she was sent flying.

“A supreme overlord.” She understood the situation and took out the tube used to store the flame of the immortal.

“Must be this place.” She said.

She was none other than Xian Chengtian’s disciple who survived the meeting with Li Qiye back in the dream world.

She picked up the tube that was abandoned by Li Qiye and studied it. Since she was the most talented among Xian Chengtian’s disciples, she learned enough to reach this minor realm.

Unfortunately, the second barrier got the best of her. She realized the gravity of the situation because if she had found this place, so would Li Qiye.

“This is bad.” Her first reaction was to flee.

“Too late for that.” Li Qiye’s voice came from the minor realm and the second barrier deactivated.

She was scared out of her mind to hear his voice, realizing she stood before the gate of hell.

She activated all her dao power and used her best movement steps to run with lightning speed.

“Get down.” High Priest Mu took action instead and sent a dao law to capture her.

She crossed through one dimension after another and sent out treasures including her master’s.

“Bam!” The law blasted through the treasures and coiled around her.

She lost control entirely because it sealed her body and true fate, dragging her into the minor realm like a meteor.

It dropped her before Li Qiye. She wanted to get up but he pressed down his foot, immobilizing her. Just a bit more force and he would pulverize her true fate.

She turned ashen with despair. He started by concealing the room, preventing anyone else in this realm from noticing.

“Xian Chengtian’s disciple.” The high priest frowned.

She was shocked to see a hidden overlord in this tiny realm. She knew all the current overlords in Three Immortals even if she hadn’t met them in person. This man was unknown.

“Impressive talent, to be able to find this clue. Far superior than Seventy-two’s group.” Li Qiye glanced at the fire-starter tube in her hand and smiled.

She didn’t answer, regretting her impatience and running here without analyzing the situation.

“Know why you are still alive?” He asked.

“Still of use somehow.” She took a deep breath.

“Yes.” He said: “Your master might not appear in Old World but this is Heaven World, he’ll come.”

He then deactivated all the barriers in the minor realm, allowing everyone to enter freely.

Her expression darkened and she uttered coldly: “I care not for death once captured. Kill me.”

“That’s too bloody.” He shook his head.

“You don’t need to try to use me as a bait. I will not ask for help and he will not come here.” She said.

“Don’t be so sure, he’ll appear since there is an intent on you.” He said.

“It’s useless, I will not call for help.” She said seriously.

“Such loyalty, picking death instead of leaving him exposed.” He said.

“I will die due to my lack of ability, this has nothing to do with my master. Do what you must.” She said.
